stable.notes: Speakers has three views: Meetings to review, Samples to review, and Voices. Voices lists every enrolled speaker with their sample count and confidence: the share of their scored speech the server matched confidently, with the average match under it. Samples to review is the Add a voice card on its own, and the toolbar and breadcrumbs stay on screen however long a list gets. Pair with server 6.45.5.
